title: Airy Japanese Chicken Tendon Bake
description: A fluffy, low‑carb one‑pot Japanese dish that uses shortcrust pastry and scallop shells to create a tender chicken tendon bake. The pastry encases the tendons and seals in a savory glaze for a crisp, airy crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Gently rinse chicken tendons and pat dry; trim any excess fat or stringy parts.
Mix soy sauce, mirin, dashi, minced garlic, grated ginger, sesame seeds, and a pinch of salt to create the glaze.
Brush each scallop shell with a thin layer of olive oil and lay a sheet of shortcrust pastry over the shell, pressing the edges to seal the shell.
Spread the glaze evenly over the pastry, then arrange a small cluster of chicken tendons on top.
Fold the pastry up around the tendons, sealing the edges with a fork to keep the shell intact during baking.
Bake for 25 minutes until the pastry is golden and crisp and the tendons are cooked through.
Once baked, remove from oven, sprinkle sliced green onions over the top, and serve immediately.
